title: Quantinuum + Rolls-Royce + Riverlane + EPCC: industrial algorithm blocks on Helios, scaling to Sol/Apollo
summary: Multi-year hybrid quantum-HPC collaboration runs computational building blocks on Helios with Riverlane QEC expertise and explicit scaling assessment toward Sol and Apollo.
actionable: Confirms Helios roadmap continuity and real algorithm workloads on the trapped-ion anchor machine (HYP-013 platform); partnership news rather than a new record.
